description: Manage Timeline's single files: one object's interpolables and keyframes saved on their own, so an animation can be reused on another character or in another scene. Saving writes the interpolables bound to 'object_id' — for a character it also stores the animation the character is playing, and loading restores it. Loading merges into the timeline rather than replacing it: interpolables that already exist take the file's keyframes. Files live in Timeline's own folder next to its DLL, not in UserData. Requires the Timeline plugin.

name.description: file name without the .xml extension; required by load, save and delete

object_id.description: scene object the interpolables belong to (id from studio_list_objects); required by load and save

overwrite.description: save only: replace an existing file of that name

output.description: 'list' returns {files: [{name, size, modified}]}; 'save' returns that one entry; 'load' returns the timeline state filtered to the object; 'delete' returns {deleted}
